title: Strict representative witness for scalar/tensor transport
statement: For fixed l,E,L,iota,W, calculi SE,SL and derived isomorphism α, a strict witness packages a pair of good cochain complexes, their scalar-good data, and the strict normalization predicate DerivedSigmaModel.

proof.text: The fields are exactly the strict cochain data occurring in DerivedSigmaModel, with no completed tensor or total limit.

lean.statement:
theorem strictTensorWitness_of_derivedSigmaModel (W : Scheme.{u})
    (SE : CoefficientDerivedSystemCalculus.{u, u} l E W)
    (SL : CoefficientDerivedSystemCalculus.{u, u} l L W)
    (α : SE.systemClosed.tensor ⋙ integralComparisonDerivedSequenceScalar.{u, u} l E L ι W ≅
      (integralComparisonDerivedSequenceScalar.{u, u} l E L ι W).prod
        (integralComparisonDerivedSequenceScalar.{u, u} l E L ι W) ⋙ SL.systemClosed.tensor)
    (hα : DerivedSigmaModel l E L ι W SE SL α)
    (P Q : Complex l E W) (hP : Good l E W P) (hQ : Good l E W Q) :
    ∃ w : StrictTensorWitness l E L ι W SE SL α, w.P = P ∧ w.Q = Q
